descriptions.notStarted: Juliet received a Snowfield Rose with Romeo's true feelings laden in it. I better go see her and see how she feels about the present.
descriptions.inProgress: Juliet was so happy about Romeo's Present that she wanted to give Romeo something in return. After taking some time wondering what would be the perfect present for him, she decided to... make him some clothes. She's an alchemist... how will she make clothes for him? Anyway, since Juliet asked for help, I'll need to see #bSirin#k of #bAriant#k.
descriptions.completed: When I told Sirin of Juliet's story, she told me to wait for a second. She didn't seem to be sweating it one bit.
